storyline.label: DeepSeek Flash
storyline.latest_title: Rival.io Launches GraphX, Running DeepSeek V4 Flash on Just Eight NVIDIA L4 GPUs

prior_narrative.tldr: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash first showed up in deployments: Dolphin's inference API went live Oct 11 and AMD MI355X posted AA-AgentPerf results Oct 14. Two OrcaRouter comparisons on Oct 16 then priced it against Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Step 5 Preview.

status.detail: Flash-1017 is out; an independent risk evaluation was published Oct 26.

beats.headline: V4.1 Flash reaches inference providers and AMD benchmarks
OrcaRouter prices Flash against Nemotron 3.5 and Step 5 Preview
Flash-1017 ships with stronger coding, cheaper inference and a search API
beats.summary: Harness v0.2.1-rc1 surfaced the same day with an unannounced snapshot.

beats.headline: Roundup places Flash-1017 among open releases; a third-party paper evaluates its safety risks

open_questions: Do independent evals confirm Flash-1017's agentic gains over larger rivals?
Is the new search API priced and rate-limited for production use?
Is the unannounced snapshot a separate model or the same Flash-1017?
What do the paper's loss-of-control and manipulation findings say about Flash-1017 under agentic use?
prior_narrative.take_for_builders: Rerun your agent eval and cost-per-task numbers on Flash-1017 before switching, read the Oct 26 risk evaluation before granting it autonomy or tool access, and test the search API against your current tool.

day_captions.f045e22fb623d831: Independent read: beats larger rivals on agentic tasks at lower per-task cost.
day_captions.a50f300013a679ed: Adds the first public access to DeepSeek's proprietary search API.
day_captions.c17f7f361be66b3c: Confirms a faster Flash model plus the search API.

day_captions.a9c17daa5dbfcba0: Newest: independent third-party evaluation of Flash-1017 for loss-of-control and harmful-manipulation risks.

prior_narrative.whats_new: A third-party paper (Oct 26) evaluates DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 for loss-of-control and harmful-manipulation risks, adding independent safety evidence to a release that so far had only performance and price coverage.
prior_narrative.why_it_matters: Flash-1017 is cheaper and stronger on agentic tasks, and an independent safety evaluation now exists. Teams giving it autonomy or tool access can weigh its findings alongside cost-per-task numbers.
